title: Tour
blurb: One agent builds a small site on a feature Branch: fs edits, an install and a failing build fixed and rebuilt in Workspaces, a server that keeps unmount refused Busy until it is stopped, a stale Workspace that merges on commit, two Workspaces in one Sandbox, and two publishes, the second overwriting the first.
prompt: Build the small site on a feature-home Branch: edit the home page, add an about page, install and build it in a Workspace (fix the build if it fails), run the server and check it, then publish feature-home and a header Branch to main.

bash.description: Edit the home page's heading on feature-home

root.say: Reads need no Workspace either: fs.list shows the Branch's /app as committed.

bash.description: Install and build in a Workspace
Escape the apostrophe and build again
Serve the site; unmount while it runs

root.note: A running process owns its Workspace: unmount is refused Busy until the server is stopped.

bash.description: Write CHANGELOG.md while a Workspace is mounted, then commit it

root.note: The fs write lands after the mount, so the Workspace is stale; its commit merges with the head and keeps CHANGELOG.md.

bash.description: Two Workspaces of feature-home in one Sandbox
Fork header from the build Commit

root.reply: main has header's files only: publish overwrites, and feature-home's Layer stays in history. Merge first to keep both.
